name: squilo
description: Query SQL Server databases with code, read only.
long_description: Runs JavaScript scripts of Squilo pipelines against the SQL Server databases of the targets listed in your Squilo config file, in parallel, inside transactions that are always rolled back. Scripts combine results across databases, targets and the files in ~/.squilo/inputs, and can write JSON or Excel reports to ~/.squilo/results.

tools.name: targets
tools.description: Lists the targets that run can read

tools.name: databases
tools.description: Lists the databases of a target

tools.name: run
tools.description: Runs a read-only JavaScript script of Squilo pipelines

tools.name: save_config
tools.description: Replaces the config with servers and targets set up with the user
